shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तु भाषितं वाक्यं मम राम शुभाक्षरम् । प्राञ्जलिः प्रत्युवाचेदं स स्वर्गी रघुनन्दन ।। 7.78.1 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu bhāṣitaṃ vākyaṃ mama rāma śubhākṣaram | prāñjaliḥ pratyuvācedaṃ sa svargī raghunandana || 7.78.1 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, भाषितं spoken, वाक्यं words, मम my, राम O Rama, शुभाक्षरम् auspicious-worded, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रत्युवाच replied, इदं this, सः he, स्वर्गी the celestial being, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: O Rama, O delight of the Raghus, having heard my auspicious words, that celestial being replied with folded hands.
comments: The being tells that he was Shveta, king of Vidarbha, who won Brahma's world by penance but, having given no charity in life, was doomed there to eat his own ever-renewing flesh until Agastya should free him -- begging the sage to accept his ornament and release him, Shveta is freed, his body perishes, and he ascends to heaven -- and this is the ornament Agastya now bestows on Rama.

shloka_text: शृणु ब्रह्मन्पुरा वृत्तं ममैतत्सुखदुःखयोः । अनतिक्रमणीयं हि यथा पृच्छसि मां द्विज ।। 7.78.2 ।।
transliteration: śṛṇu brahmanpurā vṛttaṃ mamaitatsukhaduḥkhayoḥ | anatikramaṇīyaṃ hi yathā pṛcchasi māṃ dvija || 7.78.2 ||
translation: शृणु listen, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, पुरा formerly, वृत्तं the story, मम my, एतत् this, सुखदुःखयोः of joys and sorrows, अनतिक्रमणीयं unavoidable, हि indeed, यथा as, पृच्छसि you ask, मां me, द्विज O twice-born.
explanation: O Brahmana, O twice-born, listen to this unavoidable story of my past joys and sorrows, as you have asked me.

shloka_text: पुरा वैदर्भको राजा पिता मम महायशाः । सुदेव इति विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु वीर्यवान् ।। 7.78.3 ।।
transliteration: purā vaidarbhako rājā pitā mama mahāyaśāḥ | sudeva iti vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu vīryavān || 7.78.3 ||
translation: पुरा formerly, वैदर्भकः of Vidarbha, राजा king, पिता father, मम my, महायशाः greatly renowned, सुदेवः Sudeva, इति thus, विख्यातः famous, त्रिषु in three, लोकेषु worlds, वीर्यवान् valorous.
explanation: Formerly, my father was a greatly renowned and valorous king of Vidarbha, famous in all three worlds by the name Sudeva.

shloka_text: तस्य पुत्रद्वयं ब्रह्मन्द्वाभ्यां स्त्रीभ्यामजायत । अहं श्वेत इति ख्यातो यवीयान्सुरथो ऽभवत् ।। 7.78.4 ।।
transliteration: tasya putradvayaṃ brahmandvābhyāṃ strībhyāmajāyata | ahaṃ śveta iti khyāto yavīyānsuratho 'bhavat || 7.78.4 ||
translation: तस्य his, पुत्रद्वयं two sons, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, द्वाभ्यां from two, स्त्रीभ्याम् wives, अजायत were born, अहं I, श्वेतः Shveta, इति thus, ख्यातः known, यवीयान् the younger, सुरथः Suratha, अभवत् was.
explanation: O Brahmana, he had two sons born from two wives; I was known as Shveta, and the younger one was Suratha.

shloka_text: ततः पितरि स्वर्याते पौरा मामभ्यषेचयन् । तत्राहं कृतवान्राज्यं धर्म्यं च सुसमाहितः ।। 7.78.5 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pitari svaryāte paurā māmabhyaṣecayan | tatrāhaṃ kṛtavānrājyaṃ dharmyaṃ ca susamāhitaḥ || 7.78.5 ||
translation: ततः then, पितरि when the father, स्वर्याते had gone to heaven, पौराः the citizens, माम् me, अभ्यषेचयन् consecrated, तत्र there, अहं I, कृतवान् did, राज्यं kingship, धर्म्यं righteous, च and, सुसमाहितः very attentively.
explanation: Then, when my father had passed away to heaven, the citizens consecrated me, and I diligently performed righteous kingship there.

shloka_text: एवं वर्षसहस्राणि समतीतानि सुव्रत । राज्यं कारयतो ब्रह्मन्प्रजा धर्मेण रक्षतः ।। 7.78.6 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi samatītāni suvrata | rājyaṃ kārayato brahmanprajā dharmeṇa rakṣataḥ || 7.78.6 ||
translation: एवं thus, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, समतीतानि passed, सुव्रत O virtuous one, राज्यं kingdom, कारयतः while ruling, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, प्रजा subjects, धर्मेण righteously, रक्षतः while protecting.
explanation: O virtuous one, O Brahmana, thus thousands of years passed while I ruled the kingdom and protected the subjects righteously.

shloka_text: सो ऽहं निमित्ते कस्मिंश्चिद्विज्ञातायुर्द्विजोत्तम । कालधर्मं हृदि न्यस्य ततो वनमुपागमम् ।। 7.78.7 ।।
transliteration: so 'haṃ nimitte kasmiṃścidvijñātāyurdvijottama | kāladharmaṃ hṛdi nyasya tato vanamupāgamam || 7.78.7 ||
translation: सः that, अहं I, निमित्ते on an occasion, कस्मिंश्चित् some, विज्ञातायुः having known my lifespan, द्विजोत्तम O best of Brahmanas, कालधर्मं the law of time (death), हृदि in my heart, न्यस्य having placed, ततः then, वनं to the forest, उपागमम् I went.
explanation: O best of Brahmanas, having known my lifespan due to some cause, I then accepted the law of time in my heart and went to the forest.

shloka_text: सो ऽहं वनमिदं दुर्गं मृगपक्षिविवर्जितम् । तपश्चर्तुं प्रविष्टो ऽस्मि समीपे सरसः शुभे ।। 7.78.8 ।।
transliteration: so 'haṃ vanamidaṃ durgaṃ mṛgapakṣivivarjitam | tapaścartuṃ praviṣṭo 'smi samīpe sarasaḥ śubhe || 7.78.8 ||
translation: सः that, अहं I, वनं forest, इदं this, दुर्गं inaccessible, मृगपक्षिविवर्जितम् devoid of deer and birds, तपः penance, चर्तुं to perform, प्रविष्टः entered, अस्मि I am, समीपे near, सरसः of the lake, शुभे auspicious.
explanation: I entered this inaccessible forest, devoid of deer and birds, to perform penance near an auspicious lake.

shloka_text: भ्रातरं सुरथं राज्ये ह्यभिषिच्य महीपतिम् । इदं सरः समासाद्य तपस्तप्तं मया चिरम् ।। 7.78.9 ।।
transliteration: bhrātaraṃ surathaṃ rājye hyabhiṣicya mahīpatim | idaṃ saraḥ samāsādya tapastaptaṃ mayā ciram || 7.78.9 ||
translation: भ्रातरं brother, सुरथं Suratha, राज्ये in the kingdom, हि indeed, अभिषिच्य having consecrated, महीपतिम् as king, इदं this, सरः lake, समासाद्य having reached, तपः penance, तप्तं performed, मया by me, चिरम् for a long time.
explanation: Indeed, having consecrated my brother Suratha as king in the kingdom, I reached this lake and performed penance for a long time.

shloka_text: सो ऽहं वर्षसहस्राणि तपस्त्रीणि महावने । तप्त्वा सुदुष्करं प्राप्तो ब्रह्मलोकमनुत्तमम् ।। 7.78.10 ।।
transliteration: so 'haṃ varṣasahasrāṇi tapastrīṇi mahāvane | taptvā suduṣkaraṃ prāpto brahmalokamanuttamam || 7.78.10 ||
translation: सः that, अहं I, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, तपः penance, त्रीणि three, महावने in the great forest, तप्त्वा having performed, सुदुष्करं very difficult, प्राप्तः attained, ब्रह्मलोकं the world of Brahma, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.
explanation: Having performed very difficult penance for three thousand years in the great forest, I attained the unsurpassed world of Brahma.

shloka_text: तस्य मे स्वर्गभूतस्य क्षुत्पिपासे द्विजोत्तम । बाधेते परमोदार ततो ऽहं व्यथितेन्द्रियः । गत्वा त्रिभुवनश्रेष्ठं पितामहमुवाच ह ।। 7.78.11 ।।
transliteration: tasya me svargabhūtasya kṣutpipāse dvijottama | bādhete paramodāra tato 'haṃ vyathitendriyaḥ | gatvā tribhuvanaśreṣṭhaṃ pitāmahamuvāca ha || 7.78.11 ||
translation: तस्य of that, मे to me, स्वर्गभूतस्य having become heavenly, क्षुत्पिपासे hunger and thirst, द्विजोत्तम O best of Brahmins, बाधेते afflict, परमोदार O most generous one, ततः then, अहम् I, व्यथितेन्द्रियः with distressed senses, गत्वा having gone, त्रिभुवनश्रेष्ठम् to the best of the three worlds, पितामहम् to the grandfather, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: O best of Brahmins and most generous one, even after attaining heaven, hunger and thirst afflicted me, causing my senses distress, so I went and spoke to the grandfather, Brahma, the best of the three worlds.

shloka_text: भगवन्ब्रह्मलोको ऽयं क्षुत्पिपासाविवर्जितः । कस्यायं कर्मणः पाकः क्षुत्पिपासानुगो ह्यहम् ।। 7.78.12 ।।
transliteration: bhagavanbrahmaloko 'yaṃ kṣutpipāsāvivarjitaḥ | kasyāyaṃ karmaṇaḥ pākaḥ kṣutpipāsānugo hyaham || 7.78.12 ||
translation: भगवन् O venerable one, ब्रह्मलोकः Brahma's world, अयम् this, क्षुत्पिपासाविवर्जितः devoid of hunger and thirst, कस्य of what, अयम् this, कर्मणः of action, पाकः fruit, क्षुत्पिपासानुगः followed by hunger and thirst, हि indeed, अहम् I.
explanation: O venerable one, this Brahma-loka is free from hunger and thirst, so what deed's consequence is it that I am indeed still afflicted by hunger and thirst?

shloka_text: आहारः कश्च मे देव तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ।। 7.78.13 ।।
transliteration: āhāraḥ kaśca me deva tanme brūhi pitāmaha || 7.78.13 ||
translation: आहारः food, कः what, च and, मे for me, देव O god, तत् that, मे to me, ब्रूहि tell, पितामह O grandfather.
explanation: O divine grandfather, please tell me what my food should be.

shloka_text: पितामहस्तु मामाह तवाहारः सुदेवज । स्वादूनि स्वानि मांसानि तानि भक्षय नित्यशः ।। 7.78.14 ।।
transliteration: pitāmahastu māmāha tavāhāraḥ sudevaja | svādūni svāni māṃsāni tāni bhakṣaya nityaśaḥ || 7.78.14 ||
translation: पितामहः the grandfather, तु indeed, माम् to me, आह said, तव your, आहारः food, सुदेवज O son of a good god, स्वादूनि delicious, स्वानि your own, मांसानि flesh, तानि those, भक्षय eat, नित्यशः always.
explanation: The grandfather, Brahma, then told me, "O son of a good god, your food shall be your own delicious flesh, which you must eat constantly."

shloka_text: स्वशरीरं त्वया पुष्टं कुर्वता तप उत्तमम् । अनुप्तं रोहते श्वेत न कदाचिन्महामते ।। 7.78.15 ।।
transliteration: svaśarīraṃ tvayā puṣṭaṃ kurvatā tapa uttamam | anuptaṃ rohate śveta na kadācinmahāmate || 7.78.15 ||
translation: स्वशरीरम् one's own body, त्वया by you, पुष्टम् nourished, कुर्वता while performing, तपः penance, उत्तमम् excellent, अनुप्तम् unsown, रोहते grows, श्वेत O white one, न not, कदाचित् ever, महामते O great-minded one.
explanation: O great-minded and white one, your body, which you nourished through excellent penance, will not grow back once consumed, just as something unsown never sprouts.

shloka_text: तृप्तिर्न ते ऽस्ति सूक्ष्मा ऽपि वने सत्वनिषेविते । पुरा तु भिक्षमाणाय भिक्षा वै यतये नृप । न हि दत्ता त्वयेन्द्राभ यस्मादतिथये ऽपि वै ।। 7.78.16 ।।
transliteration: tṛptirna te 'sti sūkṣmā 'pi vane satvaniṣevite | purā tu bhikṣamāṇāya bhikṣā vai yataye nṛpa | na hi dattā tvayendrābha yasmādatithaye 'pi vai || 7.78.16 ||
translation: तृप्तिः satisfaction, न not, ते to you, अस्ति is, सूक्ष्मा even a little, अपि even, वने in the forest, सत्वनिषेविते inhabited by creatures, पुरा formerly, तु but, भिक्षमाणाय to one begging, भिक्षा alms, वै indeed, यतये to an ascetic, नृप O king, न not, हि indeed, दत्ता given, त्वया by you, इन्द्राभ O Indra-like one, यस्मात् because, अतिथये to a guest, अपि even, वै indeed.
explanation: O King, even a little satisfaction is not yours in this forest inhabited by creatures, because formerly, O Indra-like one, you did not give alms to a begging ascetic, nor indeed to any guest.

shloka_text: दत्तं न ते ऽस्ति सूक्ष्मो ऽपि तप एव निषेवसे । तेन स्वर्गगतो वत्स बाध्यसे क्षुत्पिपासया ।। 7.78.17 ।।
transliteration: dattaṃ na te 'sti sūkṣmo 'pi tapa eva niṣevase | tena svargagato vatsa bādhyase kṣutpipāsayā || 7.78.17 ||
translation: दत्तम् charity, न not, ते to you, अस्ति is, सूक्ष्मः even a little, अपि even, तपः penance, एव only, निषेवसे you practiced, तेन therefore, स्वर्गगतः having gone to heaven, वत्स O child, बाध्यसे you are tormented, क्षुत्पिपासया by hunger and thirst.
explanation: You have not given even a little charity, having only practiced penance; therefore, O child, even after reaching heaven, you are tormented by hunger and thirst.

shloka_text: स त्वं सुपुष्टमाहारैः स्वशरीरमनुत्तमम् । भक्षयित्वामृतरसं तेन तृप्तिर्भविष्यति ।। 7.78.18 ।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ supuṣṭamāhāraiḥ svaśarīramanuttamam | bhakṣayitvāmṛtarasaṃ tena tṛptirbhaviṣyati || 7.78.18 ||
translation: सः that, त्वम् you, सुपुष्टम् well-nourished, आहारैः with food, स्वशरीरम् your own body, अनुत्तमम् excellent, भक्षयित्वा having eaten, अमृतरसम् the nectar-like essence, तेन by that, तृप्तिः satisfaction, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: You, having eaten the nectar-like essence of your own excellent body, which was well-nourished with food, will then find satisfaction.

shloka_text: यदा तु तद्वनं श्वेत अगस्त्यः सुमहानृषिः । आगमिष्यति दुर्धर्षस्तदा कृच्छ्राद्विमोक्ष्यते ।। 7.78.19 ।।
transliteration: yadā tu tadvanaṃ śveta agastyaḥ sumahānṛṣiḥ | āgamiṣyati durdharṣastadā kṛcchrādvimokṣyate || 7.78.19 ||
translation: यदा when, तु but, तत् that, वनम् forest, श्वेत O Śveta, अगस्त्यः Agastya, सुमहानृषिः the great sage, आगमिष्यति will come, दुर्धर्षः unconquerable, तदा then, कृच्छ्रात् from distress, विमोक्ष्यते he will be liberated.
explanation: But, O Śveta, when the great and unconquerable sage Agastya comes to that forest, then you will be liberated from your distress.

shloka_text: स हि तारयितुं सौम्य शक्तः सुरगणानपि । किं पुनस्त्वां महाबाहो क्षुत्पिपासावशं गतम् ।। 7.78.20 ।।
transliteration: sa hi tārayituṃ saumya śaktaḥ suragaṇānapi | kiṃ punastvāṃ mahābāho kṣutpipāsāvaśaṃ gatam || 7.78.20 ||
translation: सः he, हि indeed, तारयितुम् to save, सौम्य O gentle one, शक्तः capable, सुरगणान् the hosts of gods, अपि even, किम् what, पुनः then, त्वाम् you, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, क्षुत्पिपासावशम् under the sway of hunger and thirst, गतम् fallen.
explanation: Indeed, O gentle one, he is capable of saving even the hosts of gods; how much more so can he save you, O mighty-armed one, who have fallen under the sway of hunger and thirst?

shloka_text: सो ऽहं भगवतः श्रुत्वा देवदेवस्य निश्चयम् । आहारं गर्हितं स्वशरीरं द्विजोत्तम ।। 7.78.21 ।।
transliteration: so 'haṃ bhagavataḥ śrutvā devadevasya niścayam | āhāraṃ garhitaṃ svaśarīraṃ dvijottama || 7.78.21 ||
translation: सः that, अहम् I, भगवतः of the venerable one, श्रुत्वा having heard, देवदेवस्य of the god of gods, निश्चयम् the resolve, आहारम् food, गर्हितम् condemned, स्वशरीरम् my own body, द्विजोत्तम O best of brahmins.
explanation: O best of brahmins, having heard the resolve of the venerable god of gods (Shiva), I consider my own body as condemned food.

shloka_text: बहून्वर्षगणान्ब्रह्मन्भुज्यमानमिदं मया । क्षयं नाभ्येति ब्रह्मर्षे तृप्तिश्चापि ममोत्तमा ।। 7.78.22 ।।
transliteration: bahūnvarṣagaṇānbrahmanbhujyamānamidaṃ mayā | kṣayaṃ nābhyeti brahmarṣe tṛptiścāpi mamottamā || 7.78.22 ||
translation: बहून् many, वर्षगणान् years, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmin, भुज्यमानम् being consumed, इदम् this, मया by me, क्षयम् destruction, न not, अभ्येति reaches, ब्रह्मर्षे O Brahmarshi, तृप्तिः satisfaction, च and, अपि also, मम my, उत्तमा supreme.
explanation: O Brahmin, O Brahmarshi, though this body has been consumed by me for many years, it does not undergo destruction, and my satisfaction is also supreme.

shloka_text: तस्य मे कृच्छ्रभूतस्य कृच्छ्रादस्माद्विमोचय । अन्येषां न गतिर्ह्यत्र कुम्भयोनिमृते द्विजम् ।। 7.78.23 ।।
transliteration: tasya me kṛcchrabhūtasya kṛcchrādasmādvimocaya | anyeṣāṃ na gatirhyatra kumbhayonimṛte dvijam || 7.78.23 ||
translation: तस्य of that, मे me, कृच्छ्रभूतस्य who has fallen into distress, कृच्छ्रात् from distress, अस्मात् from this, विमोचय release, अन्येषां for others, न not, गतिः a way, हि indeed, अत्र here, कुम्भयोनिम् the pot-born, ऋते without, द्विजम् the brahmin.
explanation: Therefore, release me, who am in this great distress, from this predicament, for indeed, there is no other way or refuge here for anyone except the pot-born brahmin (Agastya).

shloka_text: इदमाभरणं सौम्य तारणार्थं द्विजोत्तम । प्रतिगृह्णीष्व भद्रं ते प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ।। 7.78.24 ।।
transliteration: idamābharaṇaṃ saumya tāraṇārthaṃ dvijottama | pratigṛhṇīṣva bhadraṃ te prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 7.78.24 ||
translation: इदम् this, आभरणम् ornament, सौम्य O gentle one, तारणार्थम् for deliverance, द्विजोत्तम O best of brahmins, प्रतिगृह्णीष्व please accept, भद्रम् good fortune, ते to you, प्रसादम् favor, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you ought.
explanation: O gentle one, O best of brahmins, please accept this ornament for my deliverance; may good fortune be yours, and you ought to grant this favor.

shloka_text: इदं तावत्सुवर्णं च धनं वस्त्राणि च द्विज । भक्ष्यं भोज्यं च ब्रह्मर्षे ददात्याभरणानि च ।। 7.78.25 ।।
transliteration: idaṃ tāvatsuvarṇaṃ ca dhanaṃ vastrāṇi ca dvija | bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca brahmarṣe dadātyābharaṇāni ca || 7.78.25 ||
translation: इदम् this, तावत् indeed, सुवर्णम् gold, च and, धनम् wealth, वस्त्राणि clothes, च and, द्विज O brahmin, भक्ष्यम् food to be chewed, भोज्यम् food to be eaten, च and, ब्रह्मर्षे O Brahmarshi, ददाति gives, आभरणानि ornaments, च and.
explanation: O brahmin, O Brahmarshi, this indeed gives gold, wealth, clothes, food to be chewed, food to be eaten, and ornaments.

shloka_text: सर्वान्कामान्प्रयच्छामि भोगांश्च मुनिपुङ्गव । तारणे भगवन्मह्यं प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ।। 7.78.26 ।।
transliteration: sarvānkāmānprayacchāmi bhogāṃśca munipuṅgava | tāraṇe bhagavanmahyaṃ prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 7.78.26 ||
translation: सर्वान् all, कामान् desires, प्रयच्छामि I grant, भोगांश्च and enjoyments, मुनिपुङ्गव O best among sages, तारणे for crossing over, भगवन् O venerable one, मह्यं to me, प्रसादं grace, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you ought.
explanation: The king pleaded with Agastya, "O best among sages, O venerable one, I grant all desires and enjoyments; please grant me the favor of liberation."

shloka_text: तस्याहं स्वर्गिणो वाक्यं श्रुत्वा दुःखसमन्वितम् । तारणायोपजग्राह तदाभरणमुत्तमम् ।। 7.78.27 ।।
transliteration: tasyāhaṃ svargiṇo vākyaṃ śrutvā duḥkhasamanvitam | tāraṇāyopajagrāha tadābharaṇamuttamam || 7.78.27 ||
translation: तस्य his, अहं I, स्वर्गिणो of the one desiring heaven, वाक्यं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, दुःखसमन्वितम् filled with sorrow, तारणाय for liberation, उपजग्राह I accepted, तदाभरणम् that ornament, उत्तमम् excellent.
explanation: Having heard the sorrowful plea of that king who desired heaven, I accepted his excellent ornament for the purpose of his liberation.

shloka_text: मया प्रतिगृहीते तु तस्मिन्नाभरणे शुभे । मानुषः पूर्वको देहो राजर्षेर्विननाश ह ।। 7.78.28 ।।
transliteration: mayā pratigṛhīte tu tasminnābharaṇe śubhe | mānuṣaḥ pūrvako deho rājarṣervinanāśa ha || 7.78.28 ||
translation: मया by me, प्रतिगृहीते having been accepted, तु indeed, तस्मिन् in that, आभरणे ornament, शुभे auspicious, मानुषः human, पूर्वको former, देहः body, राजर्षेः of the royal sage, विननाश perished, ह indeed.
explanation: Indeed, as soon as that auspicious ornament was accepted by me, the former human body of that royal sage perished.

shloka_text: प्रनष्टे तु शरीरे ऽसौ राजर्षिः परया मुदा । तृप्तः प्रमुदितो राजा जगाम त्रिदिवं सुखम् ।। 7.78.29 ।।
transliteration: pranaṣṭe tu śarīre 'sau rājarṣiḥ parayā mudā | tṛptaḥ pramudito rājā jagāma tridivaṃ sukham || 7.78.29 ||
translation: प्रनष्टे having perished, तु indeed, शरीरे body, असौ that, राजर्षिः royal sage, परया with supreme, मुदा joy, तृप्तः satisfied, प्रमुदितो greatly delighted, राजा king, जगाम went, त्रिदिवं to heaven, सुखम् happily.
explanation: Indeed, when his body perished, that royal sage, the king, filled with supreme joy, satisfied and greatly delighted, happily ascended to heaven.

shloka_text: तेनेदं शक्रतुल्येन दिव्यमाभरणं मम । तस्मिन्निमित्ते काकुत्स्थ दत्तमद्भुतदर्शनम् ।। 7.78.30 ।।
transliteration: tenedaṃ śakratulyena divyamābharaṇaṃ mama | tasminnimitte kākutstha dattamadbhutadarśanam || 7.78.30 ||
translation: तेन by him, इदं this, शक्रतुल्येन by one equal to Indra, दिव्यम् divine, आभरणं ornament, मम to me, तस्मिन् on that, निमित्ते occasion, काकुत्स्थ O descendant of Kakutstha, दत्तम् given, अद्भुतदर्शनम् of wondrous appearance.
explanation: O Kakutstha, this divine ornament of wondrous appearance was given to me by that king, who was equal to Indra, on that very occasion. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 78 ।। Thus ends the seventy-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
